source_title: Israeli settler attacks and military lockdown upend Palestinian olive harvest
source_excerpt:
Carrying bats, five settlers stormed farmer Yousef Abu-Aisha’s house in a village near Nablus in the occupied West Bank in the dead of night. As soon as the 43-year-old farmer opened the door, he told NBC News in an interview, the brutal beating began.
